summary.en: Method and provenance, not an independent theory: a discipline of thought and writing, and a salvage list of projects known only through memory files. Only method claims are mapped, through the README's and synthesis's paraphrase. Part of the discipline is stated in the account's method chapter, some under other names (what a summary keeps, sycophancy as selection). Those agreements are with method sections, not laws, and the two grew in one line of work, not traced here, so they are not independent support; one checked law has a like form, on type formation. Other links are readings proposed here. Divergence was looked for and is large: one owned premise against two; no one root against one root; no numbered creeds against tables of names; frame-diagnosis against answering what an objection says; value words recast into systems terms against a definition carrying no warrant.

name.en: The method is the commitment applied to the writing; the medium must not contradict the message

source.locator: Opening; On thinking, 'Never reduce to one root'; Reflexes, opening

sense.en: The folder's own thesis: one substantive commitment and one method commitment are the same thing, the second being the first applied to the writing. Each recurring failure of a collaborator is the diagnosed dynamic reproducing itself inside the collaboration, so a lossy edit is the same error the theory names.

entries.quote: the medium contradicting the message

reading.en: The account also turns on itself: its laws are read on the work that states them, selection's reach on its checks and, by analogy, joint excess on its people's attention and endless generation on its completion, its nearest to the medium not contradicting the message. All are labelled readings. It does not make method and ethics one: nonduality is a requirement of method and proves no ethical necessity, and no law evaluates a lapse as the disease at work. [AI reading]

says.en: [AI reading, D66] The laws apply to the work that states them. Its parallel lines each draw on the attention of the people who carry it; the work is not a flow, and that law is used only by analogy. Completion is not closure, also only by analogy: an account of an unfolding that keeps generating is not finished by sealing it; one reading of completion has the work's own making readable as a case of the central laws.

Knowing, modelling and criticizing happen inside the unfolding, so their adequacy is part of the inquiry. Nonduality is a requirement of method; it proves neither the ontology nor an ethical necessity.

account_adds.en: What each reading of the work rests on, and that a clean run of its checks is completion in a qualified sense only.

source_adds.en: That method and substantive commitment are one commitment, and that each failure is the diagnosed dynamic, which the synthesis calls the cluster's thesis. The account reads a law on its own making without calling that law's course a failure.

name.en: The research cycle: raw note, delegated elaboration, synthesis prompt, correction on a named ground

source.locator: Working method; synthesis-all.md §5 and §8

sense.en: Work moves in a four-move cycle whatever the object: a raw note marking its own holes, machine elaboration read as a reviewer, a synthesis prompt demanding rigour, and rejection on a named ground, where almost all the signal lies. Of thirteen formulations of one principle the README says each step changed what makes it defensible, not what is held true, so rejected versions are worth as much as the survivor.

entries.quote: Nothing in that sequence is a change of mind about *what* is true.

reading.en: The account keeps rejected forms too: T2's row records each restatement and narrowing beside its failure. But a frozen test, specified without the verdict, moves a thesis there, and a narrowing changes what is claimed. The source's own review charged conclusions settled first with vocabularies cycled underneath, judged to land halfway; and its sequence demoted reversibility, a change of claim, so the sentence quoted overstates. The live text keeps no cycle of drafts. [AI reading]

says.en: An investigation proceeds in an order that can be revised, including defining the specification without reference to the verdict. A report classes each gap: a relation omitted, an explanation not yet given, or evidence against a stated claim.
A failure stays recorded beside the thesis. T2's row: its former wording failed in beetle cultures (UE31b), so it was narrowed on 6 November 2026, no completed verdict changing. T2 is conjectured.

account_adds.en: An order in which the specification comes before the verdict, a three-way classing of gaps, and a thesis that can be moved by a test.

source_adds.en: The rejected formulation as the unit of evidence, and the claim that a sequence of rejections changes ground and not belief.

name.en: The first test is coherence, and the target is a text impossible to dismiss

source.locator: Working method, elaboration and synthesis prompt

sense.en: An elaboration is gated first by whether it connects with what its author already thinks, not by novelty; a synthesis is accepted when it is compelling, precise and impossible to dismiss, going beyond the original depth.

entries.quote: impossible to dismiss

reading.en: The account's stated criteria differ: what a claim excludes, kept apart from how far it is established, and a verdict on its central results against prior work, a test of novelty the source does not apply first. No line of descent is asserted. Fit does enter, for readings only: decided by argument and fit within the account, not with a thinker's prior view, changing no theorem. The source's later falsifiers (see that entry) are nearer the account. [AI reading]

says.en: A theory of the world is judged by what it forbids. Strength is the observations a claim excludes; standing is how far it is established; the two are kept apart.

targets.part: the opening on strength and standing

says.en: None of the central results is new mathematics: each is near-definitional or a known result restated. The verdicts come from an AI review, and the search was not exhaustive.
The readings stand as one account; where two did not fit, the account decided between them. They change no theorem and add no premise.

account_adds.en: A verdict against itself, stated at the front, and a column of what prior frameworks state that the account does not yet.

source_adds.en: That coherence with a thinker's prior view is a useful first gate, and 'impossible to dismiss' as a target. Neither is stated.

name.en: Check provenance, including your own

source.locator: The discipline he holds, On thinking

sense.en: Ask of a term or an insight, your collaborator's or your own, whether it was invented here or stands elsewhere first: the same reflex pointed two ways. The README says it later became the claim-status ledger.

entries.quote: Check provenance, including your own.

reading.en: §8 asks this of the central results: each set against its closest prior result, with a verdict and a column of what the prior work has and the account lacks; the check is an AI review, not exhaustive, and says so. Of names, 06 reports how many are new or unchecked. Other terms and single insights get no such check, so the source's scope is wider. A shared practice, not a law. [AI reading]

says.en: Each central result has its closest prior result and a verdict (near-definitional, restated, new as an artefact), from an AI review of the literature it knew; the search was not exhaustive.

Of 449 names, 248 carry a citation; of the 201 without, 105 are new combinations of old characters, a convention of this edition, and 96 are marked old or compound names whose pre-Qin use was not checked.

account_adds.en: A table, a verdict for each row, readers who searched to refute the column, and dated limits that lapse when the account states the result.

source_adds.en: The same question of every term and insight as it appears, one's own included; and that it grew into a status ledger, which sorts standing and not origin.

name.en: Never reduce to one root

source.locator: The discipline he holds, On thinking

sense.en: Called the most important rule in the file: finding the one root and folding everything into it is reductionism performed on the thinking itself. Only a plurality of principles held in tension, each partial and none crowned, can approach adequacy; 'keep them plural' is itself one voice.

entries.quote: Never reduce to one root.

reading.en: The account has one grammar, begins from one relational unfolding, the nearest of its words to the interbeing the source demoted to one voice, and states as its target one unified, complete, enclosed theory. It meets the worry elsewhere: root laws forbid no relation, the class is left free, one unfolding is an argued thesis, a root diagram an aid a branch can revise, and 99 of 117 central declarations stand at a named distance. It holds no principles in tension. [AI reading]

says.en: The target: one unified, complete, enclosed theory with zero axioms, meaning no substantive axiom. The necessity is a target, not an axiom, and no impossibility is claimed.

Of 117 central declarations, eleven are derived as cases of grammar laws, one under a stated hypothesis, six are counting, and 99 stand at a named distance, each with its reason. None is a premise; the continuation condition for scope and C for order are listed apart and neither stands on the edge.
A shared law states a mechanism many central results share; the name ranks no law above another and rules nothing.

The account begins from one relational unfolding. A finding in a branch can show a limit of the central account's current articulation and require its revision. A diagram with a root and descendants is an aid, not a finished foundation with applications attached.

Definition. A class is a reflexive, symmetric and transitive relation. Reading [AI reading, D69]: 'the class is plural', the 墨经 naming four samenesses, each a class once its respect is fixed. Plural kinds of sameness, not plural principles.

account_adds.en: A measured edge: how far one root reaches, row by row, and which distances have reasons.

source_adds.en: That adequacy needs several principles held in tension and that unifying is itself the error. The account takes unification as its target, and its live defeaters of the one-unfolding thesis do not include this objection.

name.en: One principle is one model, and one model is smaller than reality

source.locator: The discipline he holds, On thinking, 'Never reduce to one root'

sense.en: The argument behind plurality: any single principle is a model, any model is necessarily smaller than what it models, so no single formulation can be adequate, and a plurality can approach adequacy.

entries.quote: one principle is one model, and one model is necessarily smaller than reality

reading.en: The account states the premise: a model represents selected relations. 'Smaller' has exact forms: a selection reaches only what couples into it, and a summary smaller than a history needs its own proof for each question. Plurality has one too: a pool reaches the union of its members' closures and no further, and reaching is not responding. Self-reading stands apart: the diagonal gap holds of a whole family. These concern couplings and maps; reading principles through them is mine. [AI reading]

says.en: The process unfolds; the theory seeks to explain it; a model represents selected relations, and a model formed within the unfolding can take part in it.

Theorem (World; no premise). Two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when they are alike through them; the same for a group's pooled coupling. That an actual selection goes through the couplings is supplied, not derived.

Theorem (World; balance for the gap). A group's closure is the union of its members' closures; with the members listed and coupling decided, some selection through the pool separates two histories exactly when some member does not couple them alike. Differences beyond the union stay unselected.
Theorem (any process). A configuration can carry the relevant past; any smaller summary needs its own proof for the questions asked.

Theorem (any type). Where a map moves every value, no member of a family of readings indexed by what it reads says the diagonal gap; completing it step by step is an unfolding incomplete at every step that never returns. Coding and provability are not stated.

account_adds.en: The hypotheses under which a gap exists, that a family is complete exactly where all values are equal (values compared decidedly, both types inhabited), and that a pool stays blind beyond the union.

source_adds.en: That a plurality of principles held in tension approaches adequacy, and 'smaller than reality' as a general statement. No law here measures how near.
